facts.text: Andrew and Audrey volunteered with animals at a pet shelter, which they described as one of the most rewarding experiences they have had.

evidence.quote: You nailed it! That's why we went volunteering with animals. It has been one of the most rewarding things I've ever done.
Yeah we had a blast volunteering. It's our way of giving back and making their lives better!

facts.text: Andrew and Audrey believed that their volunteering with animals brought them joy, comfort, and a sense of being understood.

evidence.quote: They really do lift our spirits with all their love, joy, and comfort.
Animals really have a way of brightening our day and giving us lots of love and joy.
They listen without judging and give us the best unconditional love. They always leave a mark in our hearts and remind us how it feels to be seen and understood.

facts.text: Audrey expressed that the pet shelter likely appreciated the help provided by Andrew and Audrey during their volunteering.

evidence.quote: I'm sure the pet shelter really appreciated your help too!

facts.text: Audrey believed that Andrew and Audrey's kindness and care would make the animals at the shelter happier.

evidence.quote: I'm sure your kindness and care will make them happier no doubt!
